== Original and remastered records ==
The original and remastered lists are generated from separate image-bound records for all 310 cards. Original spelling and intentional blank game text are retained. The source image archive preserves the previous forum, Category One and Andy Talaga catalog. The original quotation marks on Twilight Fading and We Would Be Honored If You Would Join Us are indistinct; uncertain outer quotation marks are omitted from their original transcriptions and the affected source references identify this limitation. Existing historical rules prose is unchanged.

== Separate card articles and full-card audit ==
The original playtest and remastered versions have separate card articles, with one source image on each article and links between versions. Existing original article URLs are retained. Only remastered articles carry the implemented 15-series GEMP IDs; no uncoded original IDs are assigned. The original list is transcluded on the set hub. Credits are described as a game concept rather than a card type.

The whole-card audit includes title markers, Episode I icons, character and vehicle statistics, location icons, and bottom credit coins. Previously copied table credit values were corrected against the images. The original Tarkin title is Governer Tarkin; its remaster is Governor Tarkin. Original Executor prints landspeed 2, while the remaster prints hyperspeed 2. The original Anakin printed power 3 is circled, with a handwritten 1 below it. These original/remastered differences are retained, not resolved into one version. Rule-derived fields cite the Advanced Rulebook; no new gameplay rules or card-image edits are part of this pass.

== Independent remastered set and list layout ==
The independent [[Reflections Gold Remastered]] set hub separates the remastered edition from the cancelled Decipher set. Both full lists now follow [[Premiere Limited]] with linked side/type headings and 200-pixel card thumbnails, retaining all audited Lore and Credits cells. The original hub illustrates credits with [[A Gift (Reflections Gold)]], combo cards with [[Beggar & Revolution (Reflections Gold)]], and intentional blanks with [[Anakin Skywalker (Reflections Gold)]]. All 310 remastered articles change only their set parameter and explicit set category. No card text, statistics, images, GEMP implementation or gameplay rules are changed. Publisher metadata remains unchanged in this narrow pass; the new hub makes no claim that Decipher published the remaster.

The preserved virtual-slips reference on [[Sets]] covers sets 0–23. The pre-existing dates for later sets remain unchanged in this layout pass; that older capture does not establish them.

== Illustrated comparison and Yoda restoration ==
[[Reflections Gold (remaster changes)]] now pairs the original and remastered images once per changed card, summarizes all changed fields and identifies known approvals separately from differences requiring review. Bill explicitly restored [[Yoda, Jedi Master (Reflections Gold Remastered)]] to destiny 1; with no other recorded difference, its comparison row is removed. Other suspect mechanics are not changed in this pass.

[[A Gift (Reflections Gold)]] differs from its remaster only in Undercover/undercover capitalization. Its earlier approved Force-drain wording repair restored the original wording and is not a new mechanical change. [[Return Of A Jedi & Luke's Back (Reflections Gold)]] and its remaster both print Reserve deck, so that spelling concern is not an original/remaster difference. The current original [[Jedi Rocks (Reflections Gold)]] scan appears to read whatever; Bill previously reported whenever. The comparison retains the established original transcription and records this reading uncertainty rather than silently changing it.

The remastered [[Wookiee Strangle & We'll Find Han (Reflections Gold Remastered)]] image prints Wookie with one final e; the comparison records this spelling difference while existing article identities remain unchanged. [[Main Page]] now lists Independent sets after Virtual Modern. No other card text, statistics or gameplay rules are changed.
